content.text:
All 46 active tests pass.

Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: Added `rejectNegativeDamageAmounts` in `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_09-57-57_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking/src/claim-office.ts`, called as the first statement in `claim()` before any matching or reimbursement arithmetic. It throws `Error("Damage amount must not be negative")` when any entry has `amount < 0`.

**Result**: All tests now pass (46 passing, 8 todo).

**Approach**: This is minimal — a single guard using `some(...)` with a literal `< 0` check, placed ahead of the existing pipeline so no downstream code changes. No general validation framework, no other amount rules (zero, non-numeric, upper bounds), no restructuring of the existing rejection helpers even though `takeInsuredItemFor` also throws. The message satisfies the test's `/negative|invalid amount/i` via the word "negative" alone.

One observation for the Refactor phase, not acted on here: `claim()` now has two separate rejection concerns (unknown/uninsured item types, negative amounts) validated at different points in the flow, which may want a shared name.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
